watchlist.name: Arqit Quantum Inc.
watchlist.volume_trend: Volume remains light and below average (Sept 4 close volume ~149K vs. ~709K average; recent daily volumes mostly in the 150K-350K range over the past month, well under the ~236K-709K averages seen earlier in the year) — no volume expansion or accumulation signature.

signals.insider_buying: None. No new Form 4 filings of any kind since July 21, 2026 (most recent filings on record) — zero new insider activity since Monday Sept 7. All Form 4 activity in the trailing 3 months is limited to RSU/option exercises (M-EXEMPT), stock awards (A-AWARD), and open-market SALES by directors (Ritchie, Lefebvre d'Ovidio, Calabria) and officers (CRO Jennifer Bers sold $177,529 on June 22; General Counsel Patrick Willcocks sold $117,920 on June 30). Over the trailing 3 months insiders sold a net ~79,073 shares (~$2.25M) with zero open-market cash purchases — insiders remain net sellers only.
signals.institutional_buying: No new 13F/13G filings since Monday. A Sept 7 MarketBeat item on Bank of New York Mellon Corp's ~$2.95M/99,146-share ARQQ position is a republication of the prior (Q2 2026) 13F disclosure, not a new filing. Existing institutional base (Defiance ETFs, Penserra Capital Management, UBS Group, Legal & General, Renaissance Technologies, Millennium Management, Citadel Advisors) shows large prior-quarter increases already reflected in the prior screen; no incremental new stake or fresh accumulation since Monday.
catalysts: 2026 Annual General Meeting scheduled for today, Sept 8, 2026 at 4:00pm British Summer Time (11:00am ET) in London — as of this screen (~9:00am ET) the meeting has NOT yet occurred; shareholders are voting on an ordinary resolution to re-elect directors Carlo Calabria and Andrew Leaver for three-year terms. Proxy materials were filed via 6-K on August 19, 2026, and proxies were due by 11:59pm BST Sept 7. No AGM results have been announced yet — results are typically released via 6-K shortly after the meeting concludes.

Arqit's Nasdaq-listed public warrants (ARQQW) expired at 5:00pm New York time on September 3, 2026 and were delisted after Nasdaq suspended trading following the September 2, 2026 close — a previously known, non-market-moving housekeeping event, not a new catalyst.

Sept 1, 2026: Arqit, Es'hailSat and AIEE announced a successful demonstration of quantum-safe security across Es'hailSat's live satellite communications infrastructure in Doha — this predates Monday's screen and is not a new catalyst this cycle.
No new contract wins, partnership announcements, or regulatory news specific to the Sept 5-8 window were identified.
analyst_moves: No new analyst rating changes or price-target revisions since Monday. Coverage remains thin: HC Wainwright & Co. (Scott Buck) maintains a Buy rating with a $60 price target (last reiterated/maintained Oct 13, 2025); consensus from the single actively-tracked analyst is Strong Buy/Buy at $60. Separately, some aggregators (MarketBeat) show a broader 'Hold' consensus blending additional non-primary ratings (one Buy, one Sell), including a Weiss Ratings 'sell (d)' restatement (Aug 21) and a Wall Street Zen upgrade from 'strong sell' to 'sell' (Aug 8) — both predate this screening window and are unchanged.

watchlist.thesis: Arqit remains a highly speculative, pre-revenue-scale quantum-safe encryption story with a real but nascent commercial ramp (H1 FY2026 revenue of $623,000 across 11 contracts, up from $67,000 a year earlier) and growing telecom/defense/government partnership traction (Sparkle, Vodafone's Tomorrow Street, Intel, 6WIND, RAD, Es'hailSat). However, this screen found no new multi-signal accumulation evidence: price is flat at $21.37 (unchanged since the last screen, as Monday was a market holiday), insiders have filed zero new Form 4s of any kind since July 21 and remain sell-only over the trailing three months, and no new institutional 13F/13G stake-building was identified since the prior screen. Today's AGM (routine director re-election, not yet convened as of this write-up) is a governance formality, not a fundamental catalyst, and warrant expiry/delisting on Sept 3 was already known. The stock sits in a wide, choppy $18-$24 range with no clear gradual breakout, so the position is held at MONITORING pending either a genuine insider cash-buying signal, a fresh institutional accumulation filing, or a material commercial catalyst (e.g., a large new contract).
watchlist.risks: Pre-revenue-scale company (H1 FY2026 revenue of just $623K) with heavy cash burn (~$2.6M/month operating costs) against a limited cash runway; insiders have been net sellers with zero open-market buying for months, which is a mild negative signal rather than a supportive one; thin analyst coverage (effectively one active covering analyst) makes the $60 consensus target low-conviction; stock remains down roughly 66% from its 52-week high of $62 and could see continued volatility around AGM outcomes, warrant-related share-count changes, and next earnings; broader quantum-computing sector sentiment (IonQ, Rigetti, D-Wave, Quantum Computing Inc.) can drive correlated moves unrelated to Arqit-specific fundamentals.
